nodes.label: Global Design Tokens
nodes.summary: Fintech palette: Primary Red, Orange, Success Green, Dark Neutral, 16-20px rounded cards, 12px buttons/inputs.

nodes.label: Pace Stitch Design Prompts
nodes.summary: High-fidelity Stitch design prompts specifying color tokens (#FF3B30, #FFB400, #25C266, #14171A), typography, and component styling.

nodes.label: Carry-Forward System
nodes.summary: Unused daily allowance carries forward to subsequent days, rewarding underspending without inflating base daily budget.

nodes.label: Base Daily Budget Calculation
nodes.summary: Daily spending allowance calculated from remaining monthly allowance divided by total/remaining budget days.

nodes.label: Dynamic Recalculation on Bills
nodes.summary: Fixed bills and non-discretionary payments reduce monthly budget and automatically adjust daily allowance.

nodes.label: People & Settlements
nodes.summary: Tracks informal lending/borrowing ('I gave money' vs 'I took money') with full/partial settlement history.

nodes.label: Student Money Tracker PRD
nodes.summary: Product Requirements Document defining core budget philosophy, dynamic daily budget pacing, carry-forward, bills, and informal debt tracking.

nodes.label: Dashboard Visual Hierarchy
nodes.summary: Primary daily screen featuring Money Left hero card, Today's Available Budget, Spent Today, Carry Forward, and Quick Actions.

nodes.label: Semantic Money States
nodes.summary: Clear color-coded money states (Red for expenses/debts, Green for income/receivables, Neutral for balances).

nodes.label: UI/UX Design Specification
nodes.summary: UI and navigation architecture: 5 primary sections (Dashboard, Transactions, People, Insights, Settings) with desktop sidebar and mobile bottom bar.
